data.name: Cli.Help
data.value:
Extreme Injector Ex command line
Usage: Extreme Injector.exe --cli (--pid <id> | --process <name>) [options] Extreme Injector.exe -c --help
Target selection: --pid <id> Select one process by PID. --process <name> Select one process by executable name. --auto-inject / --no-auto-inject Wait / do not wait for a named process. --wait-timeout <seconds> Stop waiting after this duration; 0 waits indefinitely. If a name matches multiple processes, the command fails and lists [index] window title (PID).
DLLs and exported routines: --dll <path> Add a DLL; repeat for multiple DLLs. --clear-dlls Clear the saved DLL list. --enable-dll / --disable-dll Enable / disable the most recently added DLL. --export <name> Invoke an export from the most recent DLL. --calling-convention <value> stdcall | fastcall | cdecl. --arg <type:value> Add an export argument. Types: ansi, unicode, byte, uint16, uint32, uint64, float.
Injection: --method <value> standard | thread-hijacking | ldrp-load-dll | ldrp-load-dll-stub | manual-map. --close-on-inject / --no-close-on-inject --stealth / --no-stealth --delay-before <ms> Delay before each injection. --delay-between <ms> Delay between DLLs. --erase-pe / --no-erase-pe --hide-module / --no-hide-module --hide-from-debugger / --no-hide-from-debugger --resolve-imports / --no-resolve-imports --disable-exceptions / --enable-exceptions --disable-seh-validation / --enable-seh-validation
DLL scrambling: --scramble <none|basic|standard|extreme|custom> --scramble-header-fields / --no-scramble-header-fields --remove-useless-data / --keep-useless-data --insert-sections / --no-insert-sections --shift-section-data / --no-shift-section-data --modify-code / --no-modify-code --rename-sections / --no-rename-sections --new-entry-point / --no-new-entry-point --modify-imports / --no-modify-imports --remove-debug-data / --keep-debug-data --move-relocations / --no-move-relocations --fake-debug-directory / --no-fake-debug-directory --strip-section-flags / --keep-section-flags --shift-section-memory / --no-shift-section-memory
Interface and persistence: --language <system|en|zh-CN> --random-title / --no-random-title --primary-color <#RRGGBB> --secondary-color <#RRGGBB> --text-color <#RRGGBB> --reset-settings Restore every setting to its default in memory. --save-settings Save supplied settings; may be used without a target. --reset-warnings --ack-ldrp-warning / --unack-ldrp-warning --ack-manual-map-warning / --unack-manual-map-warning --ack-scramble-warning / --unack-scramble-warning -h, --help Show this help.
